plan: Given my value of $10, I want to ensure my bid maximizes potential profit. To win, my bid should be higher than the others, but not exceed my value. An optimal bid is slightly below my value, say $9.9, to ensure profit if I win. This bid allows me to exit just before my maximum value, reducing loss risk if the price surpasses my valuation.

To maximize profit, bid slightly below my value to win if others bid close to their values. A bid of $29.9 balances winning likelihood and profit, as it ensures winning if others bid below $29.9 and paying a price just below my value if they bid higher.
